session_summary: As the Explorer & Collector, I completed a run through Gloomwood Hollow, successfully engaging a Goblin, clearing obstacles with jumps, earning 25 coins upon completion, and spending 45 coins in the marketplace to purchase and equip the Trail Cap.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow route and gathered basic completion reward coins, but lacked a dedicated in-game collection tracking interface for unique route items.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the implementation of a Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to enhance the incentive for gathering unique route collectibles.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic for 45 coins out of a total starting accumulation.
observations.recommendation: Expand the catalog with additional mid-tier exploration cosmetics and trail-themed badges to sustain collection goals.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
feature_requests.player_value: Gives collectors a clear visual breakdown of found items, completion percentages, and milestone rewards per route.
feature_requests.rationale: Without a ledger, tracking unique route collectibles like Gloomcaps or Root Relics relies purely on external notes or memory.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: An in-game collection menu tracking discovered items and rewarding completionists upon fully exploring a route catalog.

feature_requests.title: Exploration-Themed Route Modifiers and Revisit Incentives
feature_requests.player_value: Encourages replayability on completed routes by introducing rotating collectible spawn bonuses.
feature_requests.rationale: Once a route like Gloomwood is beaten, there are limited gameplay reasons to return without dynamic exploration events or bonus tokens.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce periodic 'Forager's Moon' or discovery weather modifiers that increase rare collectible drop rates on specific older routes.

keep: Rewarding route completion payouts that fund early cosmetic purchases like the Trail Cap.
Diverse thematic route options with distinct collectible items (e.g., Gloomcap, Root Relic).
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
